in_marathi.name: Chitraksh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God with the thousand eyes
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitraksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Chitraksh is a name for Varaha Avatar of Lord Vishnu, who has a thousand eyes. This form of Vishnu is revered for his all-seeing and protective nature.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God with the thousand eyes
